description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ResponseCollectorActor class, part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It tests the actor's behavior in scenarios like timeout, response collection, and handling different HTTP status codes.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ResponseCollectorActor, testing various response collection scenarios including timeout, successful collection, and handling of different HTTP status codes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem before each test.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Tests behavior when no responses are received within timeout period.

methods.name: allCollected
methods.description: Tests behavior when all expected responses are collected successfully.

methods.name: considersLiveResponseWithNonTimeoutStatusCodeAsNotFailed
methods.description: Checks that a non-timeout error status is not marked as a failure.

methods.name: considersLiveResponseWithTimeoutStatusCodeAsFailed
methods.description: Checks that a timeout status code response is marked as a failure.
